newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Petroleum to buy NZ forest estates.
newsitem.headline: NZ Petroleum to buy NZ forest estates.

text.p: New Zealand Petroleum Ltd said on Friday it had entered into a conditional agreement to acquire two productive natural forest estates for up to NZ$8.3 million.
The estates are located on the east and west coasts of New Zealand's North Island.

The directors said finance for the deal would comprise shares and convertible notes issued to the vendor, bank debt, and proceeds from a proposed partially underwritten renounceable rights issue for 31 July 1998 convertible notes.
The total forest estate has been independently valued at $14 million.

To share in the difference between the purchase price and the valuation, the vendor would receive 10 million ordinary shares at $0.08 each, and up to 5,769,232 convertible notes at $0.26 each in partial consideration.
